evidence.excerpt: Once a path forks, the drafter's top-1 accuracy drops from 89% to 18% and its top candidates often miss the true token.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: On Qwen3.5-4B and 9B, DForkTree outperforms all baselines on every benchmark, by up to 41.5% over DFlash and 15.1% over DDTree, with average speedups of up to 4.75x over autoregressive decoding.
